page.title: Indulge — Enjoy on purpose, now in Anchor
page.description: Indulge was merged into Anchor, the maintained local-first day planner, focus timer, and schedule-review app.

hero.title:
Indulge became
*part of Anchor.*
hero.lede: The useful idea survives: keep intentional pleasure, notice automatic time, and make room for what matters inside the schedule you actually follow.

screen.alt: The original Indulge onboarding, retained as product-history artwork

sections.title: The gentle behavior loop *found its right home.*
sections.lede: Anchor combines Indulge’s intentional-versus-automatic framing with the schedule, timer, interruptions, and end-of-day evidence that make the reflection actionable.

sections.title: Tie it to *a real day.*
sections.lede: Anchor compares planned and observed time and records whether a gap came from you, the outside world, a deliberate change, a human need, or remains unknown.

screen.alt: Former Indulge Life screen, retained as product history

sections.title: Protect *a better alternative.*
sections.lede: Selected life directions can shape a small evidence-linked suggestion without a score or forced rewrite.

screen.alt: Former Indulge Trade screen, retained as product history

sections.title: Retirement did not *erase data.*
sections.lede: The historical bundle identifier, SwiftData and private CloudKit identities, App Store/TestFlight record, and Hub habits records remain intact.

aside.title: Anchor fits if
aside.body: you want planning, focus, interruption capture, and behavior reflection in one place.

aside.title: It is not
aside.body: medical care, addiction treatment, Screen Time enforcement, or an adherence score.

items.a: No. It was superseded by Anchor on 24 August 2026 and has no active roadmap.
Yes. Anchor contains the original hero, all 24 pattern illustrations, all eight life-direction illustrations, and the non-moralizing selection language.
The separate Life, Trade, and History shell; long identity interview; scene-room system; future-life card; privacy-lock flow; and duplicate focus journal remain historical research.
No. Existing Apple storage identities and Hub habits records remain compatibility resources.

closing.title:
Plan the day.
*Learn what moved it.*
closing.note: Indulge has no separate roadmap or new build.

footer.summary: Indulge was merged into Anchor on 24 August 2026. Compatibility resources remain preserved.
